summary: An interactive 3D web application built with Claude Opus 5.5 that allows users to view and build official LEGO sets step by step with 3D rotation, zooming, and piece breakdowns.

post.originalText:
I gave Opus 5.5 one idea: “LEGO instructions, but in 3D.”

It built this 👇 959 official sets you can build step by step, rotate, zoom and see every part.
